```{python}

import pandas as pd
dataset_info = pd.read_csv(root + "data/datasets.tsv", sep="\t")

all_metadata = []

for i in range(len(dataset_info)):
    
    nickname = dataset_info.loc[i, "Nickname"]
    
    temp = pd.read_csv(
        root + "data/MetaData/" + nickname + ".tsv",
        sep="\t"
    )
    
    all_metadata.append(temp)

metadata = pd.concat(all_metadata, ignore_index=True)

print(metadata.head())
print(metadata.columns)
print(metadata.shape)



```
